home.question: Do you offer a free trial?
home.answer: Yes, 14 days to put it through its paces in real conditions, no credit card needed upfront. You activate, you measure, you decide.

home.question: Will my customers actually play? They aren't gamers.
home.answer: That's exactly the point. The game isn't for gamers, it's for everyone. A spinning wheel speaks to your grandma just as much as a 14-year-old. 89% of scans lead to a game launched, based on our beta data.

home.question: Can I set a minimum purchase to redeem prizes?
home.answer: Yes, you set a single threshold across all your prizes. Whether it's $0, $5, or $10, you define the minimum order needed for a customer to walk away with their prize.

home.question: Can I brand the game with my store's colors?
home.answer: It's our signature move. 13 starting templates, 100% custom color palette, your logo, your typography, your illustrations. Your customers play at your place, not at BoumRank's.

home.question: Who are you, really? French startup? Offshore team?
home.answer: 100% French team, based in Marseille, part of the Pépite Aix-Marseille University program. French support, French billing, founders reachable on WhatsApp. No hotline in Bangalore.

home.question: I'm terrible with tech. Can I really do this?
home.answer: Yes, no sweat. Setup takes 5 minutes flat: pick your game from a list, drop in your logo, click 'Activate'. We email you the printable QR code. If you can post on Instagram, you can use BoumRank.
